text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the first day of summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to become so strong during camp that not even my family's jinx will be able to hold any sway over me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To help her with that, I plan to focus on basic training since the best foundation for building crushing strength is a healthy body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One of our other goals will be to help her gain the endurance required to run all 3,000 meters of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry! Let's check out our rooms!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't you think you're getting a bit carried away?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't help it! We're by the ocean! Woo, let's train our hearts out again this year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Looks like I'm not the only one who's excited!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're not the only one eager to train! I have to make sure I win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win it, just like you did. I'll break the Satono jinx and become someone worthy of being your rival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dia! I know you can do it! And once you do, we can run together again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their fierce cries of determination echo across the summer sky. It seems summer camp is going to be a hot one this year!
